scoring_justification: T1/T2 infeasible because the verifier cannot re‑run DFT/DFPT or the Eliashberg solver; we score structural relations (ordering, μ*‑trend) together with tolerance‑based comparison of the reported λ and Tc to the paper gold.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: λ=0.59 (MgB2), 0.43 (NbB2); Tc at μ*=0.1 ~23K (MgB2), ~4K (NbB2) (abstract + Fig. 3).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: exact published numbers used as hidden references; tolerances absorb implementation spread while preserving the physical trend.

outputs.description: Average electron-phonon coupling constant λ for MgB2 and NbB2. Each entry must have material and the λ value.
Superconducting transition temperature Tc for MgB2 and NbB2 at one or more μ* values. Each entry must have material, μ*, and Tc in Kelvin.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares λ and Tc to paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances and also verifies ordering (MgB2 λ > NbB2 λ, MgB2 Tc > NbB2 Tc).

steps.description: Verify λ values for both materials match paper within tolerance and that MgB2 λ > NbB2 λ.
Verify Tc at μ*=0.1 for both materials within tolerance, ordering MgB2 > NbB2, and monotonic decrease of Tc with μ*.
